In 1996 the [[Thai Premier League]] (official name: '''Johnnie Walker Thailand Soccer League''') was established by the [[Football Association of Thailand]], sponsored by whiskey manufacturing brand [[Johnnie Walker]]. In its first season, 1996/97, the Thai Premier League consisted of 18 teams from the Kor Royal Cup. Top 4 teams in the final league table would be qualified for championship playoffs, and six teams at the bottom of the league table would be relegated to the [[Thailand Division 1 League]] which was to be created next season ([[Thai Premier League 1997|1997]]). The defending Champions of the [[Kor Royal Cup]], [[Thai Farmers Bank FC|Thai Farmers Bank]] FC, would enter the next edition of the [[Asian Club Championship]]. ==Member clubs locations== {{location map+ |Thailand |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the Thailand Soccer League 1996-97 teams |places= {{Location map~ |Thailand |marksize=11 |lat=13.746323 |long=100.527413 |label_size=60|label='''Bangkok Metro''' |position=right|mark=black pog.svg}} {{Location map~ |Thailand |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=2 |lat=11.328136|long=102.312389|label_size=60|label={{nobreak|'''Bangkok Metro teams'''

The competing clubs will be: [[Bangkok Bank FC|Bangkok Bank]], [[Stock Exchange of Thailand F.C.|Stock Exchange of Thailand]], [[Thai Farmers Bank FC]], [[TOT FC|TOT]], [[Royal Thai Army FC|Royal Thai Army]], [[Royal Thai Air Force FC|Royal Thai Air Force]], [[Sinthana FC|Sinthana]], [[Raj Pracha FC|UCOM-Rajpracha]], [[Royal Thai Navy FC|Royal Thai Navy]], [[Port Authority of Thailand FC|Port Authority]] [[BEC Tero Sasana FC|BEC Tero Sasana]] and [[Royal Thai Police FC|Royal Thai Police]]. * Another six teams, who failed to make it into the top 12 elite, [[Thailand Tobacco Monopoly FC|Thailand Tobacco Monopoly]], [[Osotsapa FC|Osotsapa]], Bangkok Bank of Commerce, [[Raj-Vithi FC|Raj Vithi]], [[Krung Thai Bank FC|Krung Thai Bank]] and Thamrongthai will join the top four teams from the old second division - [[Rayong]], [[Samut Prakan]], Royal Household Bureau and Bank for Agriculture and Co-Operatives - to make up a new second tier. It was also confirmed that there will be no play-offs for the championship this year and just one team will go either down to the Second Division and up to the first. However, the second bottom team in the top division will have to face. The second placed team in the second division to decide who takes up a place in the top 12 next year. == Top Goalscorers == === 21 Goals === * {{flagicon|THA}} Amporn Ampansuwan - [[TOT FC|TOT]] === 18 Goals === * {{flagicon|THA}} Pittaya Santawong -
